text: طراحی خیلی خوبی داره اما مناسب من نبود
author: Ftm
developer_reply: Thank you for your feedback! We’re glad you liked the design, even if Habitive wasn’t the perfect fit for you. If there’s anything specific that could have improved your experience, we’d love to hear your thoughts on contact@habitive.app—maybe it’s worth a second look and a more positive review!
